name: Wodify
description: A platform to manage gym scheduling, memberships, and class bookings.

events.d: Get a list of clients and their basic profile details.
Retrieve memberships in pages; supports sorting and setting page number and page size.
Place an active membership on hold for a specified date range
Add a membership to a client
Fetch a single invoice by ID or list invoices with sorting, paging, and optional field selection for viewing or export.
Creates a new client in wodify account.
